rdf:Description.dc:title: How Roy Changed My Life, Part 2
rdf:Description.dc:description: As grad students, Roy and I worked together on the Radical History Review. He forever after helped me make my way in the discipline, introducing me to new historical approaches and steering me toward professional opportunities.
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Gary Kornblith
